gen-gf-halant-gf-cascadia-code: Wire-thin strokes with generous space between neighbors. Halant, the serif above, has a touch more weight in its stems and spacious curve endings, so the page gets literary polish over a modern, smooth-bending Cascadia Code.
gen-gf-halant-gf-cascadia-mono: Halant's stems run just a little thicker than its connecting strokes, a restrained swell that feels refined and literary. Cascadia Mono, a plain sans with no stroke modulation, stands under it like pins in a wide board.
gen-gf-halant-gf-julius-sans-one: Halant keeps its small letters nearly as tall as its capitals. Julius Sans One makes the strongest single quality plain: a literary serif beside a sans-serif with wide gaps and no thick-thin shift.
gen-gf-halant-gf-lexend-giga: Halant leads with a refined, literary hand. Its stems carry a bit more weight than its links, while Lexend Giga, a plain sans, spends its energy on flat single-weight lines and generously tracked words.
gen-gf-halant-gf-lexend-mega: Halant is at its best in arches that thin slightly as they leave the stem, giving a literary touch. And Lexend Mega, a plain sans drawn as if with one nib, does its best work in its tall body and open c shapes.
gen-gf-halant-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta, a plain sans, reads with wide-mouthed c shapes, curves that never thin and a big x-height. Halant adds a lightly tilted nib's soft variation above it.
gen-gf-halant-gf-lexend-tera: Refined is the first word for Halant, whose thickness shifts are felt more than seen. And Lexend Tera, a sans drawn like a plotter pen, gives the strongest quality: stepping-stone spacing against a literary serif.
gen-gf-halant-gf-lexend-zetta: Soft cadence, then ribbon. Lexend Zetta, a sans-serif of constant-width strokes and tall small letters, runs widely tracked beneath Halant's fuller stems and slimmer links.
gen-gf-halant-gf-montserrat-alternates: Halant's measured swell from hairline to stem is its signature, refined and literary. And Montserrat Alternates, a sans-serif of flat single-weight linework, would feel crowded if the body were made large beside a small heading.
gen-gf-hanalei-fill-gf-graduate: Hanalei Fill is bold and commanding, with closed letters like cut stencils. Graduate, a dignified serif with open, widely spaced letters, brings the strongest quality: a heavy display face set against a bookish one.
